verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a government tax and licensing service, since such agencies can offer filing or lookup APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive workflows: the My DOR web portal, click-through return filing, manual file upload, and an automated phone line. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the transactional portal redirects every unauthenticated request, including robots.txt, to a login page, so there is no documented headless, API, or CI-usable interface.
